info.title: User Todo API
info.description: Versioned REST API for user accounts and per-user todos. Authenticate with a JWT bearer token issued by the auth endpoints.

post.description: Creates a user and returns a JWT. Duplicate emails and invalid input both yield 422 with the error envelope.

expires_in.description: Seconds until the token expires (JWT_TTL minutes × 60).

429.description: Too many attempts for this email and IP within one minute. Includes a Retry-After header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt is allowed.

post.description: Issues a JWT for valid credentials. Unknown emails and wrong passwords return the same 401 so the endpoint cannot be used to discover registered addresses.

401.description: Credentials do not match our records.

example.message: These credentials do not match our records.

429.description: Too many attempts for this email and IP within one minute. Includes a Retry-After header.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until another attempt is allowed.

post.description: Blacklists the current JWT. The same bearer token cannot authenticate again afterwards.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or already blacklisted token.

post.description: Issues a new JWT and blacklists the one that was presented. The access token must still be valid (not expired).

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or blacklisted token.

get.description: Returns status and progress for an async job owned by the caller. Another user’s uuid yields 404, not 403.

404.description: Missing or not owned by the caller.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user’s profile. Never returns another user.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or blacklisted token.

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user’s account and blacklists the current JWT. Todo cascade behaviour is owned by the todos migration and is not asserted here yet.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or blacklisted token.

patch.description: Updates the authenticated user’s name and email. Password is optional; when sent it must include password_confirmation. Changing email or password requires current_password; those changes bump token_version and blacklist the current JWT so every prior access token stops working — the client must sign in again.

current_password.description: Required when email or password is changing.

200.description: Profile updated. After an email or password change the previous bearer token is no longer valid.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or blacklisted token.

422.description: Validation failed (including email taken, or missing/wrong current_password).

get.description: Lists the authenticated user’s todos. per_page defaults to 15 and is hard-capped at 100.

post.description: Creates a todo synchronously and returns 201 with the resource.

Accepts up to 500 todo ids for async completion on the redis queue. Returns 202 with a job_id to poll at status_url. Foreign ids are skipped; already-completed todos are left alone so retries are idempotent.

get.description: Returns one todo owned by the caller. Another user’s id yields 404, not 403.

404.description: Missing or not owned by the caller.

delete.description: Deletes a todo. Returns 200 with data null for envelope consistency.

404.description: Missing or not owned by the caller.

patch.description: Updates a todo. Toggling is_completed sets or clears completed_at.

404.description: Missing or not owned by the caller.

get.description: Paginated list of every user. Restricted to the admin role via UserPolicy::viewAny. A normal authenticated user receives 403 (unlike cross-tenant todos, which stay 404).

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or blacklisted token.

success.description: Shared response and resource shapes. Mirrors ApiResponse and resources.

data.description: Payload for the operation. Shape varies by endpoint.

meta.description: Pagination meta when listing; otherwise null.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Envelope returned for failed responses, including 422 validation.

errors.description: Field errors keyed by attribute for 422; null for other failures.

email: The email has already been taken.

User.description: Public user representation (UserResource). Password is never included.

Todo.description: TodoResource. user_id is never exposed. Cross-tenant access returns 404, not 403.

JobStatus.description: JobStatusResource. Polled after an async write. user_id and internal id are never exposed; UUIDs are not enumerable across tenants.

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token returned by register or login. Send as `Authorization: Bearer {token}`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Registration, sign-in, token refresh and sign-out.

tags.name: Todos
tags.description: Per-user todos. Cross-tenant access returns 404, not 403.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Poll async job status. UUIDs are scoped to the caller.
